crossRefs.note: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
He took them, and ate in front of them.
not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
translations.bsb: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
translations.kjv: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
translations.asv: Jesus cometh, and taketh the bread, and giveth them, and the fish likewise.
